messages:
kai (docs): Quick note: drafting a tiny 'SoftHSM fallback' paragraph for on‑prem installer docs. Saw customers accidentally rely on it without understanding security tradeoffs.
omar (eng-platform): Good — keep it short. Include a one‑line command to start SoftHSM for temporary recovery and a clear opt‑in admonition.
kai (docs): Proposed snippet: `systemctl start softhsm.service` + one sentence: 'Only use SoftHSM for transient recovery; rotate keys after migration.'
rita (security): Add a security callout: require an explicit flag `--allow-soft-fallback` and warn about audit/rotation differences. Do NOT suggest lax file perms.
ben (support): Also add a quick airgap verify tip: `tar -tf airgap-bundle.tar | grep libpkcs11` and a sample installer check `installer --verify-hsm /opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so` so we can triage 'missing .so' tickets faster.
ci-bot: md-lint: 1 warning (line length). Run `./tools/lint-md --fix`.
kai (docs): I'll open a tiny PR with the paragraph + two one‑line snippets and the support tips. Ping reviewers when up. End.
